decisions.statement: A start that fails leaves every other start running.
Every start begins at once rather than in turn.
The deadline ends the waiting rather than the start.
A start still running at the deadline is left running.
A start still running at the deadline is reported as taking the whole deadline.
A start that fails is reported with the message the failure had.
A failure that is no Error is reported as the text the failure prints as.
Every start is logged as the start activates or as the start fails.
A start passing the deadline is logged once with the deadline named.
No answer is a symbol rather than a value a start could answer with.
The timer is cleared whether the answer arrived or the deadline came first.
Nothing here knows the work a start does.
Nothing here knows where a logged line goes.

definition: each start run on its own to a deadline and the outcome that start reaches
